title: Commodity backwardation→contango regime-switch event study

method.regime_proxy: 21d vs 63d log-return slope sign (state at t uses .shift(1))
method.event_date_definition: day-(SUSTAIN_DAYS) of sustained filter, forward window starts +1

notes: Regime proxy is indirect (ETF momentum slope vs true futures curve). Forward 90d windows may overlap subsequent events; per-event table reported. Verdict NULL if no statistically or economically meaningful effect.
